expected_outputs.description: Validated spec sheet for Spec Sheet Template.

implementation_notes: Lock the first vertical slice and out-of-scope list so prompts stay bounded.
Make sections stable enough that generators can fill them without rethinking the structure.
known_failure_modes: Spec Sheet Template leaves core decisions unstated, so downstream prompts grow vague again.
Out-of-scope boundaries are missing, so work expands unpredictably.
name: Spec Sheet Template
problem_solved: Locks the sections and decisions needed to turn Spec Sheet Template into a buildable spec.

summary: Machine-first template for implementation-ready app specs.
when_not_to_use: Do not use when Spec Sheet Template is still pure brainstorming and no build boundary exists.
Do not use when the spec would duplicate an existing locked contract without adding structure.
when_to_use: Use when Spec Sheet Template must turn an idea into a bounded product/build contract before implementation.
Use when Dex needs a stable spec shape that can later feed prompt generation.
